_doc: VISION-QC defect ledger. Every built section's panels are inspected by a vision agent (Read each image) against the defect checklist: anatomy (extra limbs), extra-objects, subject-count, style-drift, identity, readability. final-audit BLOCKS ship on (a) any built section not inspected, or (b) any panel with an OPEN high-severity defect. status: open | remediated | accepted-limit.

1.backend: qwen-image-edit-max (free, DashScope) + t2i --noref fallback for sheet-prone close-ups
1.remediated_note: Initial 18-panel Qwen pass: 10 pass / 8 fail. 6 defect classes found → fixed in gen-qwen.mjs: (1) colour drift from scene colour-words → HARDBW clause; (2) garbled text on papers → BLANK clause; (3) duplicate character / extra bystander → solo/no-dup clause + NEG; (4) thin coloring-book lineart → solid-black INK; (5) legacy 'drawn as a caricature:' scene meta-prefix → stripped; (6) multi-view sheet leak on tight close-ups (p2,12,13) + costume-override failure → t2i --noref fallback. Re-QC after remediation: all 18 pass, low residuals accepted below.
